title.narrative: Development of an Inclusive Green Finance Policy for PNG’s banking sector

description.narrative: PNG government has supporting policies, legislation, and regulations in place to guide public and private sector investment towards Low Emission and Climate Resilient development. The Inclusive Green Finance Policy will comprise (1) a green taxonomy based on PNG's goals and priorities, and (2) a diagnostic report on the state of green finance in PNG.

The Inclusive Green Finance Policy marks the first step towards defining what green finance is in the context of PNG, thereby facilitating – among others – future efforts to monitor, regulate, and promote green finance flows into and within the country.
